summary: Implemented large parts of the statsmodels skeleton: the import chain (statsmodels.api now imports), tools/validation, base data/model/optimizer/wrapper, OLS/WLS/GLS, GLM links/families/IRLS, descriptivestats, TSA index helpers, and numdiff/tools helpers; many areas (discrete, most stats, statespace, tsa, formula, nonparametric) remain stubbed or placeholder.
